overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that the presence of "all-team-models" in a key's model list was sufficient to skip model access checks, without considering whether the key actually belonged to a team.
why_it_breaks: The original code skipped the model-level access check whenever "all-team-models" appeared in the key's models list, regardless of whether the key had a team_id. After PR #29746 fixed `get_key_models` to return an empty model list for teamless keys with "all-team-models", the two call-path functions (`_enforce_key_and_fallback_model_access` and `can_key_call_resolved_model`) still had the old unconditional skip logic. This meant teamless keys with "all-team-models" bypassed model checks entirely and got unrestricted access. The fix adds `and valid_token.team_id is not None` to both locations so that only team-affiliated keys skip the check; teamless keys now fall through to `can_key_call_model`, which correctly denies access because the "all-team-models" sentinel cannot be resolved to an actual model.
